{"metadata":{"description":"A growing, auditable design-review palate for DSH: 13 local tools, visual training, and opt-in Apple/X reference packs.","id":"gh:1338194172","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-palate","slug":"guo6x/dsh-palate","topics":["aesthetic","deepseek-harness","design","dsh-plugin","taste"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A growing, auditable design-review palate for DSH: 13 local tools, visual training, and opt-in Apple"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"e design-review palate for DSH: 13 local tools, visual training, and opt-in Apple/X reference packs."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🍷 dsh-palate — an eye that grows"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"[](https://github.com/guo6x/dsh-palate/actions/workflows/ci.yml) 中文说明 · DeepSeek Harness plugin"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Design-audit tools measure with a fixed ruler. dsh-palate trains an eye that grows.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Most design-review plugins ship a static ruleset and apply it forever — use them once or a thousand "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"times, the judgment is identical. dsh-palate is the opposite: it keeps a **taste corpus** that *accu"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"mulates*. Every example you feed it and every principle you distill sharpens the judgment your agent"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" draws on. The more you use it, the better its eye gets."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Taste is not a gift — it's **pattern recognition built from exposure**. See enough good and bad desi"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"gn, and the rules emerge. dsh-palate turns that into a mechanism an agent can actually use:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. **Observe** — inspect a screenshot, URL, or design and name concrete visual evidence
2. **Stage**"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" — turn that analysis into examples and principles that wait in a reviewable candidate queue
3. **Co"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"nfirm** — only an explicit accept/reject decision changes the corpus; rejected ideas stay visible wi"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"thout changing taste
4. **Review** — critique a new design against the accumulated taste, not a gene"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ric checklist
5. **Calibrate** — record which recommendations actually helped; only confirmed helpfu"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"l principles gain evidence, so the palate compounds honestly"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What the agent gets"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| `palate_intake` | Stage a structured visual analysis as **pending** example/principle candidates; "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"it never changes taste by itself |
| `palate_candidates` | Inspect pending, accepted, or rejected vi"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"sual-training candidates and their source sessions |
| `palate_decide` | Apply the user’s explicit a"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ccept/reject decision; this is the only candidate-to-palate mutation path |
| `palate_review` | Asse"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"mble the accumulated taste (principles + relevant past examples) as context, so the agent critiques "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"grounded in *learned* judgment |
| `palate_feedback` | Use a `review_id` to record whether a critiqu"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"e helped and which principles were accepted or rejected; only accepted principles gain evidence |
| "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"`palate_add` | Feed an example (`good`/`bad`/`note` + reason + tags) into the corpus — grows the pal"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ate |
| `palate_learn` | Distill a new principle from experience and add it to the codified taste |
"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"| `palate_packs` | Inspect opt-in visual-reference packs and whether they are already applied |
| `p"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"alate_seed` | Apply one or more visual-reference packs exactly once, without overwriting existing ta"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"ste |
| `palate_list` | Browse the accumulated corpus |
| `palate_principles` | List the codified pr"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"inciples, ordered by evidence |
| `palate_effectiveness` | See which principles were accepted or rej"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"ected in real review feedback |
| `palate_stats` | How much taste has accumulated: examples studied,"},{"id":"p11s15","text":" principles distilled |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Ships with a **starter palate** of 12 foundational principles plus four transparent teaching example"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"s (good and bad dashboards, a readable table, and generic landing-page boilerplate), so the first re"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"view has concrete evidence — then it grows from there."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The four starter examples are inserted only when the local taste database is empty. Installing or up"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"grading the plugin never overwrites an existing palate."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Visual reference packs: Apple and X"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"`dsh-palate` also ships two **opt-in** visual-reference packs:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- `apple-product-storytelling` — one product subject per viewport, proof-led imagery, restrained CTA"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" choices, and a calm sequence of mini-campaigns.
- `x-direct-utility` — high-contrast identity, a de"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"cisive primary route, ranked secondary actions, and almost invisible supporting detail."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"They are transparent abstractions of public pages observed on 2026-08-27, not scraped assets, brand "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"copy, or templates to imitate. Start by calling `palate_packs`, then explicitly apply one or both wi"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"th `palate_seed`. Use `tag: "apple"` or `tag: "x"` in `palate_review`: the tag filters **both** matc"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"hing examples and style-scoped principles, while universal principles remain available."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"For example, ask an agent:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> Inspect `palate_packs`, then apply `apple-product-storytelling` and `x-direct-utility` with `palat"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"e_seed`. Review our product-launch page with tag `apple`, and separately review our sign-in entry fl"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ow with tag `x`. Cite the evidence; do not copy either brand’s assets, copy, or identity."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Storage**: `node:sqlite` (built into Node ≥ 22) at `$DSH_HOME/palate/`, plus human-readable `tas"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"te.md` / `principles.md` / `feedback.md` / `training.md` mirrors. Zero runtime dependencies.
- **Ret"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"rieval**: a review ranks examples against the current description using local words, tags, and Chine"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"se word fragments; when no precedent is relevant, it leaves the evidence empty instead of padding wi"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"th recent entries.
- **Feedback loop**: every `palate_review` snapshots its evidence; `palate_feedba"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ck` records the outcome, while `feedback.md` and the panel show actual acceptance/rejection data.
- "},{"id":"p22s7","text":"**The panel**: a draggable overlay shows examples studied, principles distilled, the visual-training"},{"id":"p22s8","text":" queue, recent review subjects, the exact example refs cited by each review, and recent judgments.
-"},{"id":"p22s9","text":" **Vision pairing**: inspect screenshots with a vision tool first (e.g. `modlens_read_image`) or pag"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"es with a browser, then pass the evidence to `palate_intake` or `palate_review`. The plugin never fe"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"tches, screenshots, or claims to see a raw URL by itself."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **No embedding-based semantic matching in the plugin itself** — it retrieves locally by tags, word"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s, and Chinese word fragments; the model does the deeper reasoning from the assembled context.
- **F"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"eedback is explicit** — the plugin does not guess whether a user adopted a recommendation; call `pal"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ate_feedback` after a review to form effectiveness data.
- **Training decisions are explicit** — `pa"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"late_intake` stages evidence but does not inspect a raw URL/image or learn automatically; `palate_de"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"cide` needs a clear human accept/reject decision.
- **Markdown mirrors are read-only exports** (huma"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"n edit-and-merge-back is planned).
- **Vision is delegated** — pair with a vision tool to inspect sc"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"reenshots, or a browser to inspect URLs, before staging evidence.
- **Reference packs are not clonin"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"g kits** — they preserve observable layout and hierarchy lessons, not protected assets, copy, or a p"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"romise that every page from a referenced brand is appropriate for every product."}],"truncated":true}
